scope: Eleven search-symbol storage getters and one previously uncertain mapping.

original_slot_decode.large_string_rule: DYLD_CHAINED_PTR_64_OFFSET rebase: low36 target relative to image base 0x100000000; String high8 tag is preserved and native String header32 is skipped for UTF8 bytes.

limitations: Complete denotes the finite stable-slot/value static contract only, not current compilation or SF rendering acceptance; ledger counts are unchanged.
Current slots use process-lifetime allocation rather than original DATA_CONST placement. That adaptation does not claim identical allocation effects or original addresses.
No conclusion extends to all icon assets, input methods or the complete search interface.

original_machine.instructions: ADRP x0, slot_page; ADD x0,x0,slot_offset; RET

functions.evidence: Successful original C and the full getter return a fixed String storage address. Raw slot bytes independently decode to the expected value. The current method returns a process-lifetime stable String slot, preserving pointer identity and value across repeated calls. Static storage allocation is an independent model adaptation, not a claim of identical physical addresses or allocation instructions.
functions.actual_consumer: OriginalSearchFilterSymbols.f054b2c calls this accessor in its matching branch and reads pointee; FilterBrowser.chip sends the resulting name to the real system-image factory.

functions.evidence: Round18 already checked all UInt8 tag branches, lowercased exact matching of six type values, tag2 nil, distinct unknown-type and unknown-tag fallbacks, and final slot-value projection. Only the eleven output constants remained unresolved. This review decodes every original accessor target and String slot; all names match current source, including three large strings whose chained rebases are decoded before reading the UTF8 payload. That specific uncertainty is resolved.
functions.actual_consumer: FilterBrowser.Selection.chip uses this mapping only if its existing image is nil, then flatMaps OriginalSystemImageFunctions.f0f653c to preserve optional image failure.
